(rule! (lambda (g)
  (let* ((flags (map (lambda (row) (= 1 (length (unique row)))) g))
         (lengths
           (for/list ((origin (range 0 (rows g))))
             (if (list-ref flags origin)
                 (let ((walk (lambda (step)
                         (let loop ((j (+ origin step)))
                           (if (and (>= j 0) (< j (rows g)) (list-ref flags j))
                               (+ 1 (loop (+ j step))) 0)))))
                   (+ 1 (walk -1) (walk 1))) 0)))
         (best (apply max lengths))
         (first-best (let loop ((i 0))
                       (if (or (= i (- (rows g) 1)) (= (list-ref lengths i) best))
                           i (loop (+ i 1)))))
         (last-best (let loop ((i (- (rows g) 1)))
                      (if (or (= i 0) (= (list-ref lengths i) best))
                          i (loop (- i 1))))))
    (cellmap g (r c v) (if (and (> best 0) (= (list-ref lengths r) best) (<= r (+ first-best (- best 1)))) 5 0)))))

(rule!
 ;; Discover maximal consecutive bands of fully uniform rows, irrespective
 ;; of the colors used in adjacent rows. Keep every longest band, including
 ;; ties, in gray. All other rows become black. An all-mixed grid is black.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define mask
       (for/list ((r (range 0 (rows g))))
         (= 1 (length (unique (row-at g r))))))
     (define (walk r step)
       (if (and (>= r 0) (< r (rows g)) (list-ref mask r))
           (+ 1 (walk (+ r step) step))
           0))
     (define lengths
       (for/list ((r (range 0 (rows g))))
         (if (list-ref mask r)
             (- (+ (walk r -1) (walk r 1)) 1)
             0)))
     (define longest (apply max lengths))
     (cellmap g (r c v)
       (if (and (> longest 0) (= (list-ref lengths r) longest)) 5 0)))))
